name: Back Office Hours & Closures
description: Set the usual week (open or closed, from and to) and add holiday closures with the message for the website's notice banner.
usage: Give it the /admin/hours route. Save week and closures in onSave to one place that the public footer, contact section and closed-notice banner all read, so they never disagree. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
